request: When Payrolla posts an approved payroll to our webhook, check the iswallet funding wallet balance, get a payroll approver to approve it, then pay each employee by iswallet wallet transfer or bank payout, at most 5 at a time, and report who was paid and who failed back to Payrolla.
When iswallet rejects or reverses a customer's wallet credit, tell iSpend's internal API about the exception and post it to the ops Slack channel at the same time.
When an iswallet payout fails or is reversed, text the on-call engineer with Termii and post the details to Slack.
Every 15 minutes, find top-ups in our Postgres database that have been pending for more than 15 minutes, check each one against Paystack, and mark it credited or failed.
When our loan system sends an approved loan to a webhook, verify the borrower's BVN with Dojah, get a credit officer to approve, then send the money with Paystack.
Pay supplier invoices posted to a webhook through Flutterwave; invoices above 5 million naira need a finance manager and then the CFO to approve, smaller ones only a finance manager.
When a new customer signs up, verify their NIN with Prembly; if it matches, send them a welcome SMS with Termii, otherwise email the compliance team with Gmail.
Verify a borrower's BVN with Youverify when our app calls the webhook and return whether the name matches.
Every weekday at 8am Lagos time, check our Paystack balance and post it to the finance Slack channel.
Every hour check the Moniepoint account balance and send an SMS to the treasury lead with Africa's Talking if it is below 2 million naira.
When a Paystack transfer fails, ask an operations manager whether to retry it, and if they approve send the transfer again.
When a customer completes their tenth purchase, send them 500 naira of airtime with Africa's Talking and log it in a Google Sheet.
When an applicant links their bank account through Mono, fetch their last 6 months of transactions, compute average monthly inflow in a code step, and send the result to our underwriting API.
On the 25th of every month, read the list of salary deductions from our MySQL database and submit each one to Remita after a payroll officer approves the batch.
Every night pick up the settlement report from the bank's SFTP server, store a copy in S3, and post a summary to Slack.
When Paystack confirms a successful charge, send the customer a WhatsApp receipt using our approved receipt template.
When a new merchant signs up through our webhook, post their business name and plan to the sales Telegram group.
When Anchor reports an inbound transfer to a customer's virtual account, credit their wallet in our Postgres database and send them an SMS with Termii.
Pay approved vendor payouts from a Google Sheet through Lenco every Friday, after the finance lead approves the list.
When a customer refund request arrives on our webhook, get a support lead to approve it, then refund the charge on Paystack and email the customer.
When a customer buys electricity on our app, pay the bill through Interswitch and text them the token with Termii.
When OPay notifies us of a successful collection, add a row to the collections Google Sheet.
When Breet reports a crypto deposit has been settled to naira, notify the customer by SMS and record it in MySQL.
Screen every new business customer against AML watchlists with Dojah; if there is a hit, pause for a compliance officer to decide whether to onboard them.
When a loan application is submitted, wait 2 days, then email the applicant a reminder with Gmail if they have not uploaded their documents.
